translations.web: Therefore turn to your God. Keep kindness and justice, and wait continually for your God.
translations.bsb: But you must return to your God; maintain love and justice, and always wait on your God.
translations.kjv: Therefore turn thou to thy God: keep mercy and judgment, and wait on thy God continually.
translations.asv: Therefore turn thou to thy God: keep kindness and justice, and wait for thy God continually.
